breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet and periodic. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly identifies and uses only the Dirichlet boundary condition ('The boundary conditions are Dirichlet, with u=0 on all four boundaries.'), successfully resolving the inconsistency.
